functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION foundation_poc.probe_set_marker(p_item_id uuid, p_marker text)
 RETURNS SETOF foundation_poc.probe_item
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  UPDATE foundation_poc.probe_item
  SET marker = p_marker, revision = revision + 1
  WHERE id = p_item_id
  RETURNING *;
$function$
